description: This file defines the CreatorController class within the Goteo application, handling creator-related HTTP requests such as displaying user projects and channels in the project creation flow.

classes.name: CreatorController
classes.description: Controller class managing creator profile and project views in the application.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the display of a creator's dashboard, including projects, posts, and associated channels after verifying user permissions.

methods.name: getChannelsForProject
methods.description: Retrieves the list of channels (nodes) associated with a specific project.
